topic.label: Dance
topic.desc: Dance: Dance, Culture and Performance, Choreography and Composition, Dance History, Dance Technique, Notation and Movement Analysis and Dance Science and Kinesiology.

concepts.label: Choreography and Composition
concepts.desc: Creating dances through motif, phrase, structure, space, time and dynamics.

concepts.label: Dance, Culture and Performance
concepts.desc: Dance as social and cultural practice, criticism and production for the stage.

concepts.label: Dance History
concepts.desc: Development of court, theatrical, modern and contemporary dance and its key artists.

concepts.label: Dance Science and Kinesiology
concepts.desc: Anatomy, biomechanics, conditioning and injury prevention for dancers.

concepts.label: Notation and Movement Analysis
concepts.desc: Recording and analysing movement through Labanotation and Laban Movement Analysis.

concepts.label: Dance Technique
concepts.desc: Training in ballet, modern, jazz and other techniques for alignment, control and vocabulary.

skills.label: Dance Structure Design
skills.desc: Designs the structure of a piece in sections and checks transitions, contrast and timing against the music.

skills.label: Phrase Construction
skills.desc: Builds a movement phrase from a motif with stated counts and checks it against the intended dynamics and spatial pattern.

skills.label: Dance Ethnography
skills.desc: Plans an ethnographic study of a dance community with consent and documentation methods.

skills.label: Performance Criticism
skills.desc: Writes a review of a performance describing choreography, performers and production with specific moments.

skills.label: Production Plan
skills.desc: Plans lighting, costume and stage cues for a piece and checks cue timing against the score.

skills.label: Historical Survey
skills.desc: Summarises a period of dance history and checks dates, works and choreographers against reference sources.

skills.label: Repertory Work Analysis
skills.desc: Analyses a historical dance work's context and choreography and ties each claim to sources or recordings.

skills.label: Conditioning Plan
skills.desc: Designs a conditioning program for a dancer's goals and checks load and rest against injury prevention guidance.

skills.label: Injury Risk Review
skills.desc: Reviews a movement or schedule for injury risk factors and cites the evidence behind each flag.

skills.label: Effort and Shape Analysis
skills.desc: Describes movement in effort and shape terms and checks the coding against a recording.

skills.label: Notation Transcription
skills.desc: Transcribes a described phrase into notation symbols and checks counts and body parts against the source.

skills.label: Technique Class Planning
skills.desc: Plans a technique class from warm-up to combinations and checks progression and safe loading.

skills.label: Technique Correction
skills.desc: Identifies alignment and execution faults in a described movement and pairs each with a correction cue.
